To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a novel framework for efficient data collection from sensor nodes in a network, using flying sensor nodes as a data collection medium.
the proposed framework is suitable for data collection from sensor networks deployed in harsh and inhabitable terrain.
we propose a novel framework for efficient data collection from a ground based sensor network using flying sensors.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: 1. Design and development of sensor fly. 2. Design and development a sensor network with sensor fly. 3. Design and development an algorithm for sensor fly to cover the clusters (reffered as cluster-hops). 4. Design and development algorithms for sensor network to communicate with sensor fly.

the following issues: (a) the design and implementation of a sensor network with sensor fly as data collection entity; (b) the design of the sensor fly and its communication with the network; (c) the design and development of the fuzzy logic based algorithm for the inference of clusters that could be covered; (d) the design of a communication protocol for the sensor network and the sensor fly.

the following aspects: (1) A framework for data collection by flying sensor nodes, (2) Inference of cluster-hops covered by the sensor-fly based on input parameters, (3) Performance evaluation of the proposed framework.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

, the proposed framework for data collection is a novel approach to the conventional data collection in wireless sensors networks, which has the potential to overcome many of the inherent limitations of the conventional approach.
, in the proposed framework the sensor fly collects data from the sensor network, which is then relayed to the BS.
the proposed framework for data collection, using sensor fly, would be highly useful in a sensor network deployment in harsh terrain.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have presented an efficient data collection framework from a sensor network, using flying sensor nodes, with the objective of energy efficient communication.
a novel framework for sensor data collection using sensor fly has been proposed, and a fuzzy logic based approach for inference of the clusters covered by the sensor flies has been presented.
we have proposed a novel framework for efficient data collection from a wireless sensor network using flying sensors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the sensor nodes can be utilized for a different utility, in addition to their usual role of sensing and monitoring the physical environment.
the proposed framework is a viable alternative to conventional data collection methods in sensor networks.
the proposed framework provides a novel solution for data collection from sensor networks deployed on ground surface by utilizing flying sensors.
